howItWorks.heading:
From first message to touchdown,
we take it from there.
howItWorks.intro: You act at the start and at confirmation. We handle the rest.

steps.title: Enquire
steps.text: Tell us the date, route, number of passengers, bags and any special needs.

steps.title: Plan and quote
steps.text: We check the aircraft, crew, airports and permits, then send you a clear quote.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: We arrange permits, airport handling, catering and the crew briefing.

steps.title: Fly
steps.text: Welcome on board. We depart on time.

howItWorks.acmiNote: ACMI works differently. We agree the terms and you operate the flights under your own schedule.

about.heading:
A sense of place,
in the air.
story: Valcon Air Solutions Limited is a charter airline based at Wilson Airport, Nairobi. We started with a simple idea: flying should feel considered, not complicated.

Our first aircraft, a Bombardier CRJ200 LR registered 5Y-VAL, has arrived and is ready to work. Whether you need a charter for your team, extra capacity for your airline, or a specialised mission in a remote place, we plan it with you and fly it with care.

values.title: Considered
values.text: Every flight is planned around you.

closing.title: Request a quote
closing.support: Tell us where you need to go and when. Our team will respond with a clear, tailored quote.
